## ROOFORA — Airtable Setup Check (run by hand, once)
**Check Only** reads the base structure with your existing Airtable credential and reports what is missing or different. It changes nothing.
**Create Missing Tables And Fields** also ADDS missing tables/fields and a default Settings row. It never renames, retypes or deletes anything. Needs token scopes schema.bases:read + schema.bases:write (base creator) on the ROOFORA base only.
